chunks.text:
[Welcome]
{a warm welcome that builds: shimmering sampled strings swell over a rising timpani roll as a horn sings the bold rising three-note lift, growing for four bars into the crash that launches the anthem}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
cutting bright pulse-wave lead with wide leaping melody
sampled 16-bit drum kit and timpani on a galloping rock beat, tom fills and crash cymbals
melody built on a bold rising three-note lift
same tempo, key and instruments as the theme that follows
